criteria.detail: monthly changes: 3 of 3 shifts reach enough of the 17206 rows to be fitted, 3 of them over at least as many clusters as the fit has coefficients; levels: 3 of 3 shifts reach enough of the 20994 rows to be fitted, 3 of them over at least as many clusters as the fit has coefficients. Each fitted shift runs the real branch series and the shifted one on exactly the rows that shift reaches, so the two standard errors share a sample and a cluster count. A cluster-robust meat matrix is a sum of one outer product per cluster, so with fewer clusters than coefficients it is singular and its standard errors carry nothing; that is arithmetic and not a threshold. An arm with no surviving shift has no floor, and its reading below is not adjudicable rather than failed
criteria.name: B61-0  every comparison is a real fit and a placebo on the same rows, over enough clusters to have a covariance

criteria.detail: 80121 lines, 0 malformed, 54097 of another variety, 0 with an unreadable date or a non-positive price or arrival. 20994 rows kept across 4 states, 109 markets and 2388 days; 5030 rows dropped because their state had fewer than 3 markets reporting that day, so no leave-one-out branch exists for them

criteria.detail: dev and dev_state both subtract nat(t), so they correlate through var(nat) even under independence. corr(dev, dev_state) is 0.2358 raw, 0.1631 under a day fixed effect which absorbs nat(t) exactly, and 0.0569 with a market effect added. The regressions use the absorbed form. corr(dev, log arrivals) is -0.1807 raw and -0.2113 absorbed

criteria.name: B61-4  the rival's regressor: does the deviation load on the region's own conditions
criteria.rival_entailment: If the field is generated that way then, once the day's national level and the market's fixed position are held out, a market's deviation is explained by its own supply conditions, and the identity of the intermediary carries no further information. So the coefficient on the market's own arrivals has to clear a floor built by shifting the intermediary series, and the coefficient on the intermediary must not.
criteria.rival_premise: A distance-weighted equilibrium: the value at a position is set by that position's own conditions and its distance from the anchor. This is the branch B30-5 names in as many words, 'loads on local conditions -> the field is an equilibrium'.

criteria.detail: 20994 rows come from 109 markets in 4 states over 2388 days, and no count in this record is an independent-observation count. Standard errors are clustered on the state, which is the level the branch varies at; the iid figure is in every fit beside the clustered one. The three commodities are downstream of one market system, so a replication across them is not three independent samples
criteria.name: B61-6  what the counts are not

A cluster count says how many states there are and cannot say how many of them carry the reading, so each is dropped in turn and the figure reprinted. A state holding most of the pairs takes the reading with it when dropped and that says nothing; a state holding few of them and still moving the figure is the one to read.
